verdict.rationale: PayPal publishes catalog feed specs (Google Product Feed, OpenAI ACP Product Feed) via Store Sync that let AI agents discover merchant products, plus a docs discovery index (llms.txt) and MCP server for tool discovery — but this is product/catalog discovery for shopping, not a general published directory of payable APIs/services, and access is form-gated with narrow scope (US physical goods only). Missing for 10: an open, self-serve directory of payable services/APIs analogous to a marketplace index, evidence of discovery beyond gated merchant catalogs, and independent confirmation that agents actually browse/discover via these feeds in practice.
